title: Settle actual width-one GL2 target minima with a third dirty role (no κ)
body:
## Summary

A third fully restored dirty role does not shorten any of the 36 actual width-one GL2(F2) target pairs. This closes Open next question 1 of ywz65's PR2620. Claim type: scoped proof with an exact finite certificate. Produced by Nick Petalas.

```text
actual four-point stream = two fixed lines + natural two-dimensional summand
  -> transfer PR1495's natural-image two-SWAP exclusion
  -> complete each mixed target to two SWAPs
  -> minimum(g,h,I) = ell(g) + ell(h)
```

The new contribution is the explicit actual-module transfer and geodesic completion to the mixed-target table. commdata2338's PR1495 supplies the six-call natural-image exclusion, which is inherited and is not claimed anew. Its scientific checker is not run. ywz65's PR2620 and PR2599 supply the source question, two-role result, stream ABI and nonfaithfulness distinction. Credit Ross Richardson's PR1989/PR2415 formal adjacent-label tariff, Gareth Davidson's PR1333 affine/register reduction, ywz65's PR2544 weighted context and their retained binary/native lineage. Classical finite-graph and meet-in-the-middle methods retain their credit.

## Evidence

Before, PR2620's actual width-one classification covers two roles and leaves a restored third role open. After, the written actual-stream bridge and mixed-target completion settle all 36 three-role endpoints. This does not infer formal coefficient equality from a nonfaithful representation.

The standalone verifier uses two exact implementations, packed nine-row operators and full twelve-column operators. The first derives the paid alphabet from all 28 rank-one role projectors; the second conjugates coordinate calls by all 168 scalar bases. They agree on all 56 calls and all 46,951 radius-three states and distances. Every possible word below the direct bound is covered by the radius-two/radius-three joins.

Local CPython 3.12 checks pass:

- All 3,584 active-vector transfers and six geodesic completions.
- All 10,073 target join probes in each implementation, with no cheaper endpoint.
- All 432 full input columns of the 36 attaining words, including every dirty spectator input.
- All 113 rejection controls, including every one of 108 call omissions, a spectator leak, incomplete/false ball data, an injected short target and a known positive short-word join.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized direct checks and both registered commands. Each registered command took about 1.1 seconds locally, under its 120-second limit. These are budget observations, not a performance claim.
- Official committed export integrity and optimized replay from a read-only Git-free export with an empty executable PATH. Its generated report equals the local report and all seven exported files retain their bytes.
- Metadata/provenance pins, exact committed bytes and full declared source-history ancestry. The report is generated by execution and binds every package file by SHA256; no receipt is handwritten.

From the repository root, standard library only:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/gl2-width-one-third-role/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -O -B research/gl2-width-one-third-role/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/gl2-width-one-third-role
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/gl2-width-one-third-role --check-source-history
```

Another CPython 3.12 executable may replace the local path. Expected markers are `PASS_GL2_WIDTH_ONE_THIRD_ROLE`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. The scientific verifier imports no predecessor executable and requires no Git, network, solver or third-party package.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

Exactly three arbitrary dirty roles, one binary point column, unit-priced coordinate calls and free binary scalar mixing are essential. A fourth role, another width/alphabet, clean input promises or partial restoration changes the model. The fresh certificate covers every shorter word needed for these exact minima; it does not enumerate the whole active GL6 group or prove an all-role theorem.

The proof cites PR1495's natural-image exclusion as a premise. Its new-domain finite certificate also supplies a direct exclusion independently of that premise. Native realization, physical scalar mixing, caller access, compiler, precision/tape/stock costs, complete signed invoices and outer transfer remain separate. All five selected framework assumptions remain. No new kappa, selected-frontier change or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. No predecessor scientific suite, selected cold replay, Lean or Docker run was performed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. Every registered check ran locally.

## Open next questions

Can a fourth restored dirty role shorten a named actual width-one target pair? First specify its complete paid alphabet and a complete shorter-word certificate. The larger state domain is the immediate blocker. A written invariant for arbitrary dirty-role count must apply to the actual nonfaithful action; this package supplies no such extension.

## Related open work

The live open-PR and claim searches found no other open PR studying these actual width-one GL2 register-word minima. PR6528 studies GL2 flags for unequal decoder payloads, a different contract and quantity; no numerical comparison is asserted. PR2620, PR2599, PR1495, PR5031 and PR2544 are merged predecessors or formal-model context, with their distinct scopes credited above and in the package. Main README/general-form searches, merged searches and the cached overlap inventory were checked; arbitrary historical diffs and unpublished work remain coverage limits.

The completion refresh listed all 16 account open PRs created since the CLAIM at 2026-11-03T13:56:07Z, including this PR. None of the other 15 studies the actual width-one GL2 register-word minima. No additional scientific computations were run to check those contributions or compare unrelated quantities.

[Advance CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19375374). Canonical main remains `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, priority revision 8 and selected PR6030. The scope is unchanged from the claim; the inherited six-call case is explicitly credited.

## CI notes

Both hosted checks passed at exact head `05badc507099ead41facabc3fe0bc0653cde80e2` in [Registered research packages run 41650227032](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/41650227032): `plan` in 4m28s and `replay (research/gl2-width-one-third-role)` in 1m42s. The completed checks were read once with `gh pr checks`; run metadata confirms success and the matching head. Hosted replay executes both registered warning-strict normal and optimized commands. All local scientific and publication checks listed above also passed. CI certifies execution of these checks; independent human and formal proof-kernel acceptance remain unclaimed.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: isolated. Six new files in `research/gl2-width-one-third-role/`; shared code, frozen evidence, predecessor credit and selected-frontier artifacts remain unchanged.
